rationale: The counter's asynchronous reset is the output of a flop chain asserted asynchronously and released synchronously, a standard reset-synchronizer; no data signal drives a reset or clock.
author: claude-sonnet-5-5

provenance.adaptation: Converted to SystemVerilog and built the surrounding logic around the two-flop reset synchronizer.

labels.note: The reset synchronizer asserts asynchronously and releases through clocked stages.
